summary: Sound subsystem restart routine invoked on game restart. First calls StringSplitLoop(2, aDDevF119992002_24, 694); if that returns non-zero it writes the 'entered sound restart' debug message to the buffer global dword_8AD25C via DebugLogWrite. It then resets the virtual dispatch state on the this context, zeros the scene-camera parameter global flt_8AC4B0 via FieldZero4, and finally reinitializes the audio buffer from flt_5EA618, returning that call's result.

operations.description: Condition on StringSplitLoop(2, aDDevF119992002_24, 694) returning non-zero.
Log the 'entered sound restart' message aEnteredSoundRe through DebugLogWrite into the buffer global dword_8AD25C.
Reset the virtual dispatch state on the sound this context.
Zero the 4-byte global flt_8AC4B0 (scene camera parameter).
Final call reinitializes the audio buffer from the global flt_5EA618 (the callee address is not present in the packet callee facts).
Return the result of the buffer reinitialization call.
